text: Item last-touched-by indicator (multi-member lists) + account initials preference

Server + Android done in 852ba21, both fully tested (server: 15 new tests
across sync engine + accounts + /members; Android: 12 new/updated tests
across ListViewModel, ListScreen, Dto, ListPropsViewModel — compile,
targeted tests, and lintDebug all green).

Not closing yet: this ticket's scope includes web (basic support) —
resolve_initials on GET/PATCH /settings and account_id+initials on
GET /lists/<id>/members are already live server-side, so the web side is
purely client work (an initials field in account settings + an indicator
on the item row, simpler styling is fine per the ticket). Continuing to
that now.

Server (a124e43-era commit already covered migrations/columns), Android and web all done. Android: item last-touched-by author badge in list screen, list notes, Settings 'Display initials' UI (loadInitials/updateInitials mirroring the currency section). Web: last-touched-by badge in ItemRow (shown when list has >=2 members), Settings initials form section. Fixed a data-loss bug on both platforms proactively: the server's PATCH /api/v1/settings overwrites default_currency and initials unconditionally on every call, so updateCurrency/updateInitials (and their web equivalents) now always resend the other field's current value. Commits: fd5ff19 (T-62, prerequisite), 852ba21 (server+android core), a6fcc7a (android Settings UI + web + two test-suite bugs found during full-suite verification: AuthRepositoryTest's stale settings mock, SettingsViewModelTest's MockWebServer FIFO race).
